name: compositor-mcp-workspace
description: Deep Model Context Protocol integration for the Compositor macOS image editor

scripts.build: npm run build -w @compositor-mcp/protocol && npm run build -w compositor-mcp-server
scripts.test: npm run build:protocol && npm run test:packages
scripts.test:packages: npm run test -w @compositor-mcp/protocol && npm run test -w compositor-mcp-server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:protocol && npm run typecheck:packages
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run typecheck -w @compositor-mcp/protocol && npm run typecheck -w compositor-mcp-server
scripts.check: npm run build:protocol && npm run typecheck:packages && npm run test:packages && npm run parity && npm run docs:check
